Class CharacterCard

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am56.model.card.Card
it.polimi.ingsw.am56.model.card.characterCard.CharacterCard
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Direct Known Subclasses:
ArtistCharCard, BuilderCharCard, CollectorCharCard, HunterCharCard, InventorCharCard, ShamanCharCard
public abstract class CharacterCard extends Card
Base class for the six character cards. A character card is picked by a player during their turn and remains in their hand for the rest of the game; its Card.resolveEffect(GameModel) applies a per-type bonus at pick time, and its presence may also contribute to end-of-game scoring and to event resolution.
